info.title: osbTK Native Bridge
info.description: Typed wire contract for the osbTK native engine. Rust (`crates/osb-api`) is the source of truth; the C#, C++, Python, TypeScript, Go and Java SDK models and clients are generated from this document. Every `operationId` is the native bridge `op`.

200.description: The eased value (named easing or cubic-bezier)
The distance from a point to the curve
The polyline offset along the curve's normal
The point at `t`, parametrically or by arc length
The helper's result (a command list or scalar)
The helper's result (a keyframe channel or vectors)
The anchor offset for the origin
Whether the sprite's bounds intersect the screen
The active control point, or null
A summary of the loaded beatmap

AnimationMeta.description: Frame-cycling metadata for an animation sprite.

frames.description: Number of frames in the animation.

audioDuration.description: The audio duration in milliseconds (`0` when no audio is loaded).

timeStep.description: Fixed time step (when adaptive sampling is off).

BakedCommand.description: A linear command span produced by the bake.

BakedSprite.description: A baked sprite: a texture plus its `.osb`-compatible command spans.

BakedStoryboard.description: A baked storyboard: the 2D result of a 3D bake.

Beatmap.description: A parsed beatmap: metadata, difficulty, control points and hit objects.

audioFilename.description: The audio filename referenced by the map.

backgroundPath.description: The map's background filename from `[Events]`, if any.

comboColors.description: Combo colors from `[Colours]` (empty when the map has none).

mode.description: The ruleset mode (`0` = osu!standard, `1` = taiko, `2` = catch, `3` = mania).

Color4.description: A linear RGBA color with channels in `0.0..=1.0`.

CommandKind.description: The kind of a baked 2D command.

CommandRequest.description:
A sprite command. `start`/`end` are a scalar, a `Vector2`, or a `Color4`
depending on `kind`.

end.description: The end value (scalar, point or color).

endTime.description: The command end time in milliseconds.

oneOf.description: The parameter kind for a `parameter` command.

start.description: The start value (scalar, point or color).

startTime.description: The command start time in milliseconds.

ControlPoint.description: A timing or difficulty control point.

beatDuration.description: Beat duration in milliseconds (only meaningful on red lines).

bpm.description: Tempo in beats per minute derived from the beat duration.

omitFirstBarLine.description: Whether the first bar line is omitted.

speedMultiplier.description: Slider velocity multiplier (`1.0` on red lines).

time.description: The point's start time in milliseconds.

timingChange.description: Whether this is a red (uninherited) line.

layer.description: The target layer name (omitted when `layerHandle` is set).

layerHandle.description: The target segment handle (takes precedence over `layer`).

path.description: The texture path (relative to the mapset).

CreateSampleRequest.description: Create a sound sample on a layer.

layer.description: The target layer name (omitted when `layerHandle` is set).

layerHandle.description: The target segment handle (takes precedence over `layer`).

path.description: The sample path (relative to the mapset).

layer.description: The target layer name (omitted when `layerHandle` is set).

layerHandle.description: The target segment handle (takes precedence over `layer`).

path.description: The texture path (relative to the mapset).

oneOf.description: The initial position; omitted means the sprite's default.

CurveKind.description: The interpolation a control-point list is interpreted as.

distance.description: The signed offset along the curve's local normal.

CurvePointRequest.description: A curve query at a parametric or arc-length position.

byArcLength.description: Sample by arc length instead of the raw parameter (default `false`).
Sample by arc length instead of the raw parameter (default `false`).

count.description: The number of points to sample.

CurveSpec.description: A curve: the interpolation plus its control points.

layer.description: The layer index, when the finding is layer-scoped.

sprite.description: The sprite index, when the finding is sprite-scoped.

time.description: The time in milliseconds, when the finding is time-scoped.

DiagnosticCode.description:
A stable, machine-readable diagnostic code.

The code is the source of truth: it is the enum, and its wire value is the
dotted code string (e.g. `osb.command.overlap`).

DiagnosticReport.description: A report: the findings plus per-severity counts.

EasingResult.description: An easing function applied to a normalized time.

cubicBezier.description: A CSS-style cubic-bezier's control points `[x1, y1, x2, y2]`.

oneOf.description: A named easing (used when `cubicBezier` is absent).

crf.description: The constant-rate-factor quality (`0`-`51`; lower is better).

ErrorResult.description: The error envelope returned when an operation fails.

output.description: The output audio path (its extension selects the format).

count.description: The maximum number of frames to extract.

fps.description: The sampling rate (frames per second); defaults to the source rate.

outputDir.description: The directory to write frames into.

FftRequest.description: An FFT request against a `.wav` file.

magnitudes.description: The magnitude of each frequency bin.

FrameResult.description: The result of a frame extraction.

outputDir.description: The directory the frames were written into.

GetFftRequest.description: An FFT request against the runtime's loaded audio.

oneOf.description: The easing applied across the bins.

GetOriginVectorRequest.description: The anchor offset for an origin.

Handle.description: A stable handle to a sprite in a runtime's storyboard.

layer.description: The layer index the sprite lives on.

sprite.description: The sprite index within its layer.

HelperRequest.description: A motion-graphics helper call: a helper `name` plus its input.

input.description: The helper's input (a keyframe channel, a command list, or its parameters).

HelperResult.description:
The result of a motion-graphics helper (a keyframe channel, a command list,
a list of vectors, or a scalar).

color.description: The combo color assigned to the object.

endTime.description: The object's end time in milliseconds (equal to `start_time` for circles).

newCombo.description: Whether the object starts a new combo.

stackHeight.description: The stacking height used for visual offsets.

startTime.description: The object's start time in milliseconds.

format.description: The format (e.g. `PNG`), inferred from the path.

ImageOptions.description: Fine-grained image processing options (all optional; applied in order).

resizeHeight.description: Resize to this height (the width is derived when omitted).

resizeWidth.description: Resize to this width (the height is derived when omitted).

rotate.description: Rotate by degrees (rounded to a multiple of 90).

ImageProcessRequest.description: An image processing request: read `path`, apply `options`, write `output`.

output.description: The output file path (its extension selects the format).

ImportOsbResult.description: The result of importing a `.osb` storyboard.

InScreenBoundsRequest.description:
Whether a rotated sprite's bounding box intersects the widescreen
storyboard area.

LayerHandle.description: A stable handle to a layer in a runtime's storyboard.

LayerHandleRequest.description: Resolve (or create) a layer by name.

LoadBeatmapResult.description: A summary of a loaded beatmap.

audioCodec.description: The audio codec name, when present.

duration.description: The duration in seconds (`0` when unknown).

height.description: The video height in pixels (`0` for audio-only).

videoCodec.description: The video codec name, when present.

width.description: The video width in pixels (`0` for audio-only).

Node3dInput.description: A node in a plain 3D scene tree.

frameDelay.description: Delay between animation frames, in milliseconds.

frames.description: Animation frame paths (empty = a still sprite).

inheritsRotation.description: Whether the node inherits its parent's rotation.

inheritsZDepth.description: Whether the node inherits its parent's depth.

pivot.description: The local pivot rotation/scale act about.

OptimizeOptionsInput.description: The knobs controlling an optimization pass (all default to `false`/none).

deduplicate.description: Remove commands identical to an earlier command of the same type.

mergeAdjacent.description: Merge a command with the next when they are continuous.

removeRedundant.description: Remove zero-duration commands whose value does not change.

splitThreshold.description: Split commands longer than this many milliseconds (into linear pieces).

OptimizeResult.description: The optimized `.osb` text plus the stats.

OptimizeStats.description: The effect of an optimization pass.

oneOf.description: The point, or `null` when there is none.

OsbLoopType.description: How an animation advances after its final frame.

ParameterType.description: A sprite parameter command kind (`P` in `.osb`).

ParseOsbResult.description: A summary of a parsed `.osb` storyboard.

PathRequest.description: A request carrying a single file path.

RenderShapesRequest.description: A shape-rendering request: a canvas, a background and a shape list.

output.description: The output file path (its extension selects the format).

shapes.description: The shapes to draw, in order.

Scene3dInput.description: A plain 3D scene: nodes, a camera and bake options.

SegmentAddIndexRequest.description: Record a depth index on a segment.

SegmentChangePositionRequest.description: Move a segment to another osu! layer (`ChangePosition`).

SegmentCleanResult.description: The result of cleaning a segment.

removed.description: The number of zero-duration sprites removed.

SegmentDiscardResult.description: The result of discarding a segment.

layerCount.description: The number of remaining top-level layers.

SegmentIndexesResult.description: A segment's depth indexes and bounds.

indexes.description: The recorded indexes, in insertion order.

value.description: Whether children are emitted in reverse order.

cornerRadius.description: The corner radius for a rounded rectangle.

size.description: The size (width and height; a circle's diameter is `size.x`).

SpriteInfo.description: A sprite's initial state and metadata.

oneOf.description: Animation metadata, or `null` for a plain sprite.

flipH.description: Whether the sprite starts horizontally flipped.

flipV.description: Whether the sprite starts vertically flipped.

loopCount.description: The number of loop groups on the sprite.

rotation.description: The sprite's initial rotation in radians.

texturePath.description: The sprite's texture path (relative to the mapset).

triggerCount.description: The number of trigger groups on the sprite.

SpriteState.description: A sprite's sampled state at a point in time.

additive.description: Whether the sprite is composited additively at this time.

anchor.description:
Sampled origin offset in texture pixels, added to the enum anchor.
Zero when the origin is not animated.

SpriteTimeRequest.description: A sprite handle pair plus a sample time.

startTime.description: The loop start time in milliseconds.

endTime.description: The trigger end time in milliseconds.

name.description: The trigger name (matches a hit object).

startTime.description: The trigger start time in milliseconds.

Storyboard.description: The whole storyboard, in draw order.

StoryboardCommand.description: A single time-based command on a sprite timeline.

StoryboardCommandKind.description: The kind of a storyboard command.

StoryboardLayer.description: A layer/segment with its sprites and samples.

identifier.description: The layer/segment identifier (`""` for an anonymous segment).

osbLayer.description: The osu! layer this segment belongs to.

reverseDepth.description: Whether the segment's children are emitted in reverse order.

sprites.description: The layer's sprites, in creation order.

StoryboardLoop.description: A loop group on a sprite.

endTime.description: The loop end time in milliseconds.

startTime.description: The loop start time in milliseconds.

StoryboardSample.description: A sound sample on a layer.

path.description: The sample path (relative to the mapset).

StoryboardSprite.description: A sprite with its full command surface.

anchor.description: The initial origin offset in texture pixels.

oneOf.description: Animation metadata, or `null` for a plain sprite.

exclude.description: Whether the sprite is excluded from output (`DiscardSprite`).

flipH.description: Whether the sprite starts horizontally flipped.

flipV.description: Whether the sprite starts vertically flipped.

texturePath.description: The sprite's texture path (relative to the mapset).

StoryboardTrigger.description: A trigger group on a sprite.

endTime.description: The trigger end time in milliseconds.

name.description: The trigger name (matches a hit object).

startTime.description: The trigger start time in milliseconds.

TextRequest.description: A request carrying a block of text (an effect script, `.osu` or `.osb`).

Vector2.description: A 2D point or vector in osu! storyboard pixels.
